GenAiFunction.description: Checks the customer full name and registered mobile against Kotak records and sends the OTP. Call with empty inputs to ask the customer for them. Always pass journeyId = the journeyId output of the most recent LoanSeva action in this conversation (empty on the first call) and sessionId = the Routable Id (MessagingSession Id) of this conversation; leave sessionId empty if no Routable Id is available.
